name: tests-75pct-gh-dash-deterministic-current-section-export
instr:
Add deterministic JSON and CSV export APIs and an `ExportCurrentSection` command.

`ExportColumns` returns visible columns in configured order with nonempty machine names and decorated headers, including columns with no `Hidden` pointer; calling it keeps the current item and does not start loading. PR, issue, and branch snapshots preserve record order and source values, exclude fields belonging to other section types, and keep previously captured PR titles and issue states unchanged after later mutations. An empty PR snapshot retains its section ID, type, title, filters, a nonzero capture time, and zero records. A repository snapshot applies the local search filter, preserves branch timestamps across refreshes, and does not fabricate an absent PR association. A repository-sorted notification snapshot preserves current membership, search filters, visible columns, and CSV record order.

For visible repository columns, issue records use `Repository.NameWithOwner`, and notification records contain no repository field.
For an enriched PR, the exported comment count is the number of available enriched comment nodes, replacing the primary count.

CSV uses column headers for its header row and machine names to select values, preserving column and record order. `EncodeSnapshot` accepts only lowercase `json` and `csv`, returning no bytes and an error for unsupported formats. `WriteExport` writes the complete encoder output in the requested format and returns the destination, format, an
